children: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (KRX:000660) faces volatile trading and foreign selling amid share-price weakness and valuation near 2–3x 2027–28 earnings, even as its strong cash position, customer deals, new CXL/HBM products, a 2026 Dalian export license and role in NAND/3nm supply chain support a recovery narrative.
Previous Week Recap
Heavy Volatility, Net Foreign Selling
: SK hynix ADR (000660) saw heavy volatility: multiple double-digit drops in Seoul, frequent 2%–9% intraday moves, net foreign selling (trillions won), and falls below the 200-day moving average.
Valuation At 2–3x 2027–28 Earnings
: SK hynix (000660) trading at about 2–3x projected 2027–28 earnings, below prior upcycle 4–7x. Forecasts expect stable memory prices and profits but note AI cloud financing and Chinese supply risks.
Cash, Debt, Net Cash High
: As of June 30, SK hynix (000660) held ₩88T cash, ₩18.6T debt, net cash ₩69.4T and cash-to-debt ~4.7x; company finalized long-term agreements with about ten customers.
Export License For Dalian Plant
: SK hynix ADR (000660) received a 2026 export license for limited equipment to its Dalian plant; approval for more gear for 2027 is still pending, highlighting U.S.-China equipment export limits.
Second-Largest Global NAND Vendor
: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (000660) ranked second-largest global NAND vendor in Q2 2026 behind Samsung; excluding SK hynix’s Solidigm unit, YMTC would rise to second by NAND shipment volume.
Possible 3nm Base-Die Adoption
: SK hynix (000660) is listed as a potential adopter of TSMC’s 3nm base-die process for Nvidia’s custom HBM chips, per reports noting memory suppliers named for the switch.
256GB CXL 3.2 Memory Module
: SK hynix (000660) launched a 256GB CXL 3.2 memory module with 80 GB/s bandwidth and about 30% improved energy efficiency versus the prior model, targeted at AI memory infrastructure.
Participated In $40B Buyback
: SK hynix (000660) joined Samsung in a $40B coordinated buyback program that finished early in mid‑October; the planned late‑July buyback spike did not occur.
Hold Buy Recommendation On Slowdown
: Samsung Securities keeps Buy on SK hynix (000660), citing slower chip price gains offset by rising shipments, better product mix, HBM using existing capacity, and temporary share-price weakness.
HBM AI Specs Deadline
: SK hynix (000660) set a January 2027 deadline for final HBM-based AI flash specs. Shares fell about 1.7% on the day the news was reported.
